title: Why does adding an event handler during a handler appear to work differently from removing one?

Consider this: [CODE] When the document element is clicked for the first time, the output in the console is: [CODE] From this, it would seem that, even though the end result are two events bound in order (Handler 1 and Handler 2), a handler added inside another event handler is not added to the currently processed queue. Now consider this: [CODE] When the document element is clicked, the output in the console is also: [CODE] In this second case, the two handlers are initially bound in order, and I would presume the event queue contains both when Handler 1 is initially run, but removing an event handler is enough to also remove it from the currently processed queue.
